quarterly_data.quarter: Nokia press release: Nokia advances AI-RAN toward commercial deployment and (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nokia's AI-RAN with NVIDIA (anyRAN software on NVIDIA Aerial RAN Computer) is being integrated into live networks; operator programs as described: Elisa ran voice, mobile data and video analytics on the same AI-RAN platform in its Helsinki 5G network, with distributed deployment and evaluation of commercial AI-RAN services expected in 2027; BT is preparing a live-network trial in Birmingham in 2027; Deutsche Telekom's AI-based channel estimation showed typical uplink throughput improvements of 10-15% in initial laboratory measurements, with field validation next; Orange plans lab and real-network testing. Nokia also launched a sovereign agentic AI platform for network autonomy with NVIDIA (NVIDIA AI Enterprise and Nemotron models integrated), with etisalat UAE, MEO and Airtel identifying use cases. Dell Technologies, Quanta Cloud Technology and Supermicro support Aerial RAN Computer configurations, and Red Hat brings AI-RAN onto OpenShift.
quarterly_data.figure: lab uplink throughput +10-15% (Deutsche Telekom channel estimation)
